maria: FYI I updated the AWS Lambda quickstart auth snippet in PR #4321. It's a small refresh: switch to env var + explicit region note + remove streaming example for Lambda handler. Need a quick docs sanity pass.

sam: Nice. Is this only JS or are we adding Python too?

maria: For now just the Node example (Node 18). We should add a Python variant later but want to ship the clarity fixes first.

jordan: Paste the new handler so I can skim.

maria: Heres the snippet I pushed:

```js
// handler.js (Node 18)
import fetch from 'node-fetch'
const API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY
export async function handler(event) {
  const payload = { input: JSON.parse(event.body).text }
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=us-west-2', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_KEY}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  })
  const data = await res.json()
  return { statusCode: 200, body: JSON.stringify(data) }
}
```

tina: tiny nit: PR description spells "authntication" on line 2  should be "authentication".

sam: We should add a short "Migration from SDK v4 -> v5" note: main change is env var name and the default batching behavior. Keep it to one line.

jordan: Also add a safety callout to never check keys into repo and link to secrets guide.

maria: Agreed. I'll add the one-liner migration and a secrets crosslink. Also adding a 1-line note about increasing Lambda timeout to 30s for larger models and cold-starts.

sam: Can you add where to set the env var in the Lambda console? A screenshot placeholder would help. I'll open a follow-up PR after this merges to add screenshots.

maria: Will do. Also, for accuracy, the snippet includes region as a query param in the example URL  do we want that or prefer a comment explaining region selection?

jordan: Prefer a comment, otherwise people might think they must hardcode region in URL. Maybe show a short comment: // set REGION via env var or in dashboard.
